prompts.scene: An epic storm-blue and silver mountain ascent. Guo Shizhen, a tall HUMAN-SIZED adult Dragon-Blooded man with blue-black hair, amber slit-pupil eyes, short swept horns and fine scales along jaw and forearms, stands on the right third of the foreground in weathered layered travel robes. Three-quarter body, readable determined face angled toward the storm, wind catches robe and hair. Strong grounded stance on a fractured peak, immense dark mountain valleys and cloud shelves behind him. His Martial Art creates a few razor-clean trajectories of impossible distance originating from his feet across the heavens. No giant dragon, no giant duplicate, no wings. Lightning illuminates distant storm clouds as natural weather. The environment dwarfs him, but his presence anchors the image. Cool silver slashes, charcoal-blue mountains, one restrained warm highlight on his face. Let storm-dark negative space at left hold the title. Mood: stubborn defiance against an overwhelming heaven.

prompts.scene: Intimate dark-jade and antique-gold gothic xianxia beauty. Lin Zhenyu, a beautiful clearly adult young woman grown from a black lotus, ink-dark long hair, pale olive skin with faint petal veining, layered charcoal-green silk robes adapted around living root tissue. Waist-to-knees visible on the right side, poised human-scale, one hand resting near the hilt of an OLD STRAIGHT SWORD growing through the right side of her torso; dark lotus roots smoothly encircle blade, no injury, no blood, no gore. Thin metallic sheen only, she is Qi Gathering not immortal. Her quiet direct gaze is confident and contemplative. Behind her an ancient pond and weathered tomb garden with black lotus leaves, soft dusk reflections and drifting low mist. A few warm lanterns create real golden light; no moon and no glowing fantasy anatomy. Deep smooth green-black water at left provides title space. Mood: haunting beauty, resilience and the memory of an old wound.

prompts.scene: A cinematic vermilion, ivory and charcoal shrine painting. Han Jingsu is a striking mature adult woman formed from smooth dark mountain stone, black hair threaded with fine mineral seams, grey-green eyes, weathered cream ceremonial robes. She stands prominently on the left foreground in three-quarter body framing to knees, strong readable face turned slightly toward viewer; a stone hairpin and faded red bridal ribbons at one wrist, no bridal spectacle. Fine crystalline lines deep in forearms, her body still human-scale and pre-immortal. Behind her, quiet old mountain shrine steps with centuries of weathered offerings, red timber roof edge and misty natural cliffs, faded red ribbon moving in wind. Late autumn leaves and warm low sunlight cut through temple shade. Architectural detail rendered in clean painted shapes. The empty amber-grey mist at right holds the large title. Mood: ancient vows, patient strength, sacred melancholy.

prompts.scene: An immense celestial xianxia tableau, indigo, pearl-white, violet and soft silver. Tang Wanyue's beautiful mature adult female face with pale grey eyes and black-silver hair is the nearest readable portion of ONE astronomical Heaven Lord Qi-body. Her real white-grey wings start at the visible shoulder roots and continue as immense folded planes of hollow space spanning the wide composition, tiny spherical worlds suspended between deeper feather-like structures. Silver qi veins connect throat and wrists directly into those cosmic folds; dark layered robes merge into the same connected body. Near face and upper body on right, exquisitely clear and personal; wings sweep across upper and lower space framing dark open void at left for title. Behind and below the SAME body, a small attached damaged wing-shaped shadow, subtle and subordinate, no second person. Infinite continuous space above and below suspended worlds; no terrestrial ground, no ordinary woman standing before disconnected giant wings. Mood: astonishing sublime scale, beautiful cosmic dread. Keep title area calm dark navy.

prompts.scene: An austere black-ink, warm bronze and pale-gold cosmic martial cover. Cheng Guanhai is an entirely HUMAN-SIZED older man with weathered features, iron-grey hair, plain dark travel robes, relaxed empty hands, clear calm face. Show him knees-up at left, materially small but powerfully composed, one hand loosely lowered; no weapon, no giant duplicate, no Qi aura. Behind and around him the True Venerable Martial Art makes space difficult to assemble: exceptionally fine elegant duel trajectories reach through immeasurable celestial distance, each approaching a decisive ending and stopping one motion before victory, bending into another unresolved arc. The art belongs to action and intent, not bodily enlargement. Vast dusk-gold void, a few distant world-scale points, layers of restrained elegant arcs, no chaotic explosion or monster. Broad near-black space on right for monumental title. Mood: absolute mastery, silence before an impossible duel, terrifying restraint.
